_comment: THE PICTURES STRESS CORPUS. Generated by tools/gen-picture-corpus.py -- edit that, not this. Replayed per commit by PicturesHarness in StressGameTest: each case hangs as vanilla map art on a real wall and comes down clean, or pins a cap that must be SAID.
